patterns: APPSC asks direct author-work items: Subhadra Kalyanam - Tallapaka Timmakka, Madhura Vijayam - Gangadevi, Dasarathi Satakam - Kancherla Gopanna.
Favourite shape is 'identify the wrong match' of women poets and works (Gangadevi-Marichi Parinayam trap, APPSC-G2 2023/2025).
Recurring facts: Annamacharya as pioneer of the kriti/sankirtana form, contemporary of Saluva Narasimha; Srinatha 'not written by' lists and his court (Pedakomati Vema Reddy).
Other PSCs/UPSC test Alvar/Nayanar basics (Andal only female Alvar, Tirumurai 'Fifth Veda', Nayanars = Shaiva) and Annamacharya vs Tyagaraja (not contemporaries).
App MCQs add many multi-statement items on Tallapaka genealogy, Virashaiva terms and Srinatha's patrons - deeper than APPSC's single-fact author-work questions.
